programme.desc: Parallel cut Joe dan Clara di sebuah pagi di rumah masing-masing, siap beraktivitas. Tak lama, di kedai kopi Joe yang riuh, Joe tiba dan menyelesaikan masalah diantrian. Terlihat Rori si robot kopi yang melayani pelanggan dan memutar musik sesuai selera pengunjung. Tak lama Clara tiba menyeruak antrian, membuat pengunjung lain protes, namun ia disambut Joe yang adalah teman lamanya. Mereka pun saling menyapa dan pergi menyusuri jalanan Surabaya untuk mengenang masa lalu kala pertama Clara melihat Joe saling bertemu.

programme.title: Dunia Maya S1 E2
programme.desc: Maya mulai mendapatkan lebih banyak perhatian melalui konten DIY kecantikan karena sosok YouTube yang terkenal, Celine, terus me-roasting kontennya. Hal ini membuat Maya semakin viral hingga akhirnya ia bisa mulai memonetisasi kanal YouTube-nya. Sahabatnya, Kevin, sangat mendukung passion barunya dan membantunya dalam proses pembuatan konten.

programme.title: Dunia Maya S1 E3
programme.desc: Karier Maya sebagai influencer sedang menanjak karena ia mulai menerima undangan untuk berkolaborasi dengan YouTuber lain. Maya berusaha membagi waktu antara sekolah dan mengelola kanal YouTube yang menuntut banyak perhatian, tetapi semua distraksi ini membuatnya sulit untuk berkonsentrasi dan berprestasi di sekolah—seperti yang sudah diperingatkan oleh Misya kepadanya.

programme.title: Dunia Maya S1 E4
programme.desc: Rekaman video Ardi yang menjemput Maya dari rumahnya untuk sebuah kencan yang sebenarnya tidak berbahaya menjadi viral dan membuat Maya menjadi bahan perbincangan banyak orang. Ibu Maya, Mariska, menikmati momen ketenarannya yang singkat dan mengklaim dirinya sebagai manajer Maya.

programme.title: Dunia Maya S1 E5
programme.desc: Popularitas Maya di dunia maya tercermin pada penampilannya. Selain berpakaian lebih modern, chic, dan modis, jadwal hariannya pun menjadi semakin padat hingga ia merasa kelelahan. Nilai akademiknya pun menjadi korban, sehingga Maya akhirnya memutuskan untuk mengambil cuti satu semester dari kuliah dengan dukungan penuh dari ibunya.

programme.title: Dunia Maya S1 E6
programme.desc: Upaya Maya untuk mencari pelarian justru membuat Mariska semakin bersikap overprotektif terhadapnya. Maya mendapatkan kontrak besar sebagai Brand Ambassador untuk lini produk kecantikan ternama. Ardi jatuh sakit dan Maya merawatnya—ketika Ardi menyadari ketulusan Maya terhadap kesehatannya, ia pun mulai semakin terlibat secara emosional dengan Maya.

Pada saat itulah, Ramadan memberanikan diri untuk melamar Mona.

programme.desc: Satu Hati Untuk Garuda. Program spesial yang menampilkan semangat, dedikasi, dan dukungan tanpa henti bagi Tim Nasional Indonesia. Melalui kisah inspiratif, momen berkesan, serta semangat para pendukung, program ini menggambarkan perjalanan dan ambisi Garuda dalam mengharumkan nama bangsa di pentas internasional.

programme.title: ASEAN C'ship Hyundai Cup 2026
programme.desc: ASEAN C'ship Hyundai Cup 2026 merupakan ajang sepak bola paling bergengsi di Asia Tenggara yang mempertemukan tim nasional terbaik kawasan. Negara-negara unggulan seperti Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia, Malaysia, dan Singapura bersaing bersama tim peserta lainnya dalam format kandang dan tandang. Setiap pertandingan menjadi penentu dalam perebutan gelar juara ASEAN, dengan pertandingan berlangsung di berbagai negara peserta, bukan di satu negara tuan rumah.

programme.title: Oshi No Ko S2, Ep 23
programme.desc: Musim kedua menghadirkan perjalanan Aqua, Ruby, Kana, Akane, dan para aktor lainnya dalam mempersiapkan adaptasi panggung Tokyo Blade. Di balik proses latihan dan pertunjukan, persaingan antarpemeran, tekanan untuk memberikan penampilan terbaik, serta dinamika hubungan pribadi menjadi tantangan yang harus mereka hadapi. Sementara itu, Aqua diam-diam melanjutkan penyelidikannya terhadap sosok yang bertanggung jawab atas kematian Ai Hoshino, hingga menemukan petunjuk baru yang membawa penyelidikannya ke arah yang semakin berbahaya. Memadukan drama karakter yang emosional dengan gambaran realistis industri hiburan Jepang, musim ini menyajikan kisah tentang ambisi, pengorbanan, dan pencarian kebenaran.

programme.title: Call Of The Sea
programme.desc: Seorang nelayan muda bernama Chin Hu jatuh cinta dengan teman masa kecilnya, Hsiao Yu. Namun, putra satu-satunya preman di sana terpukau pada kecantikan Hsiao Yu dan mencoba segala cara untuk mendekatinya.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai memerankan tokoh Pak Su-cheng, dewi ular nan mempesona yang memilih wujud sebagai seorang wanita sehingga ia dapat merasakan indahnya kehidupan manusia!

programme.title: Five Superfighters
programme.desc: Seorang ahli kung fu dan tiga muridnya kehilangan segalanya usai dikalahkan oleh seorang penindas. Demi membalas dendam, ketiga murid tersebut berlatih pada master kung fu lainnya dan kembali menghadapi si penindas.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Dalam Pale Passion, disutradarai oleh Chin Ping-hsing, Chiang Li-ping berperan sebagai Ah Hsia dalam kisah perselingkuhan, perzinahan dan pengkhianatan yang menyebabkan cinta segitiga berdarah.

programme.title: Brothers Five
programme.desc: Seorang wanita muda bertekad untuk mempersatukan kakak beradik yang tengah berseteru, guna mengalahkan sekelompok pembunuh yang telah menghabisi nyawa ayah mereka.

programme.title: The Mirror And The Lichee
programme.desc: Judul yang menarik tentang dua tiang penyangga yang menandakan memulai kebahagiaan yang berakhir dengan kisah cinta yang tragis antara pria terpelajar dan seorang gadis cantik.

programme.title: Diary Of A Lady-Killer
programme.desc: Seorang pencinta wanita kaya menulis buku harian tentang petualangan asmaranya, tetapi semua wanita yang pernah diselingkuhinya telah dibunuh.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: Raja Kera dan gengnya dihadang oleh Putri Kipas Besi yang jahat, Nyonya Tulang Putih dan dua adiknya yang seksi, serta sederet karakter-karakter aneh lainnya.

programme.title: Return To The 36th Chamber
programme.desc: Dalam bagian ke-dua dari trilogi ini, Gordon Liu berperan sebagai Zhou Ren Jie yang menyamar sebagai biksu untuk belajar kung fu di Shaolin, dan akhirnya menciptakan gaya kungfunya sendiri.

programme.title: Return To The 36th Chamber
programme.desc: Dalam bagian ke-dua dari trilogi ini, Gordon Liu berperan sebagai Zhou Ren Jie yang menyamar sebagai biksu untuk belajar kung fu di Shaolin, dan akhirnya menciptakan gaya kungfunya sendiri.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: Chen Hou adalah seorang sopir yang terjebak dalam skandal salah identitas yang membawanya pada pebisnis wanita Lok Dai. Saat rumor menyebar bahwa mereka berpacaran, Lok Dai pun marah dan meminta penjelasannya.

programme.title: The Treasure Hunters
programme.desc: Film kung fu ini menampilkan aksi dua penipu yang tengah mencari emas tersembunyi bersama beberapa biksu Shaolin, seorang penjahat kejam dan sang adik yang bisu namun berbahaya.

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: Dalam drama yang mengerikan ini, aktris populer Shaw Brothers, Li Jing, berperan sebagai putri pemilik penginapan di daerah pegunungan. Ia menyaksikan aksi pemerkosaan yang dilakukan oleh salah seorang penduduk.

programme.title: The Flag Of Iron
programme.desc: Bendera Besi adalah sebuah klan berbudi pekerti luhur yang harus berhadapan dengan Perhimpunan Rajawali yang menjadi pelindung kegiatan-kegiatan ilegal.

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: Hong Kong Rhapsody adalah film musikal yang penuh dengan lagu dan tarian. Peter Chen-Ho berperan sebagai pesulap playboy yang mengubah cara hidupnya setelah menjadi penjaga seorang penyanyi muda.

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist
programme.desc: Setelah Revolusi Tiongkok, penjajah Jepang mulai menyusup ke Timur Laut Tiongkok. Dalam film ini, Arashi Tani, seorang ahli judo yang jahat, ingin membuktikan bahwa orang-orang Tiongkok adalah bangsa Asia yang lemah.

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Seorang anak dari keluarga kaya yang gemar bermain gitar bernama Yang Fan pergi ke Jepang untuk bergabung dengan sebuah band rock. Ia juga berusaha mendapatkan cinta dari dua gadis cantik.

programme.title: Operation Lipstick
programme.desc: Seorang asisten profesor mencuri mikrofilm yang menyimpan rahasia reaktor nuklir nan baru ditemukan dan menjualnya ke suatu sindikat kejahatan. Namun, benda itu jatuh ke tangan penari klub malam dan seorang pencuri.

programme.title: Ambitious Kung Fu Girl
programme.desc: Michelle Mei Suet berperan sebagai Szu-szu si gadis manja yang mengabaikan cinta sejatinya, Yang Fan, untuk mencari pendekar pedang pujaannya, Chin Ko.

programme.title: Return Of One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: Pendekar Pedang Bertangan Satu dipaksa keluar dari masa pensiunnya oleh sebuah organisasi kriminal yang terdiri dari delapan pendekar pedang, yang telah memaksa setiap klan untuk mengirimkan pendekar pedang terbaik mereka untuk bersaing melawan mereka demi supremasi pendekar pedang.

programme.title: Melody Of Love
programme.desc: Kisah asmara yang mempesona ini bercerita tentang tiga dokter yang mengejar tiga gadis cantik di era musik 'a-go-go' pada tahun '70-an.

programme.title: Song Of The Assassins
programme.desc: Seorang pembunuh mengemban misi pertamanya sambil diam-diam menyelidiki penyebab pembantaian keluarganya beberapa tahun silam. Namun, ia malah terjerat dalam suatu konspirasi politik saat menjalankan misi.

programme.title: Final Justice
programme.desc: Seorang polisi mengandalkan seorang pencuri mobil muda untuk menangkap empat gangster yang berencana merampok seorang pedagang kaya untuk mendapatkan sejumlah besar uang.

programme.title: Fight Back To School 2
programme.desc: Sing mengundurkan diri dari kepolisian setelah diturunkan pangkatnya ke bagian pengaturan lalu lintas, sementara rekannya ditugaskan dalam misi yang melibatkan teroris asing yang mengancam akan mengebom sebuah sekolah di Hong Kong, sehingga Sing memutuskan untuk membantu dengan menyamar di sekolah yang sama.

programme.title: Skyline Cruisers
programme.desc: Petualangan aksi di mana formula obat penyembuh kanker dicuri, dan tim petarung kung-fu harus mengatasi saingan dan pengkhianatan untuk mendapatkannya kembali.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi akan mewarisi kekayaan kakeknya yang tengah sekarat dengan satu syarat, yaitu ia harus menikah dalam waktu sebulan. Jika tidak, warisan tersebut akan diberikan kepada sang paman yang bernama Robert.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Sepasang suami istri miskin, Shui dan Ti, berusaha membangun kehidupan mereka sendiri. Dan melalui kerja keras mereka berdua, Shui menjadi seorang eksekutif pemasaran, kemudian sikapnya mulai berubah.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, putra dari pengusaha yang culun, mendapat kekecewaan usai mencari jodoh di Hawaii bersama temannya. Kemudian, secara tak sengaja mereka terjebak dalam sebuah pertukaran identitas yang kacau.

programme.title: The Myth
programme.desc: Arkeolog Jack terus mengalami mimpi berulang tentang kehidupan masa lalunya, di mana ia adalah Jenderal besar Meng Yi yang bersumpah melindungi seorang putri bernama Ok-Soo. Jack kemudian memutuskan untuk menyelidiki semua misteri tersebut bersama sahabatnya, William.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Seorang fotografer terjerat oleh sesosok 'wanita berbaju merah' hingga menyebabkan kerabatnya tewas satu per satu. Ia pun bersumpah untuk mencari tahu kebenarannya saat gadis yang ia sukai juga tewas secara misterius.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: Selama lima tahun, Takumi yang berusia 18 tahun mengirimkan tahu setiap pagi dengan mengendarai Toyota AE86 kuno milik ayahnya. Ia pun mengembangkan teknik balap yang sempurna dan menjadi pembalap hebat.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: Sebuah upaya pembunuhan yang gagal di Harbin, Cina pada tahun 1909 mengubah arah sejarah. Kini dua agen JBI harus menemukan hubungan antara benda tersebut dengan sebuah artefak Korea kuno.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: Sebuah upaya pembunuhan yang gagal di Harbin, Cina pada tahun 1909 mengubah arah sejarah. Kini dua agen JBI harus menemukan hubungan antara benda tersebut dengan sebuah artefak Korea kuno.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: Seorang prajurit muda Tiongkok mencuri pedang dari seorang pendekar pedang terkenal dan kemudian melarikan diri ke dunia petualangan romantis bersama seorang pria misterius di perbatasan negara.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: Sebelum memenangkan pujian dalam film laga berkat aksi-aksi mereka yang berani, para bintang ini menjalani tahun-tahun penuh darah, keringat, dan air mata saat berlatih di bawah bimbingan Master Yu yang kejam.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: Anita Yuan Yung-yi berperan sebagai seorang anak perempuan yang tidak sengaja menemukan sebuah mutiara dengan jin di dalamnya. Michael Wong berperan sebagai jin yang mengabulkan tiga permintaannya.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: Petualangan bersejarah nan epik berlatar masa-masa penuh gejolak di masa Tiga Kerajaan. Cao Cao berusaha untuk memasukkan Guan Yu ke dalam pasukannya, tapi Guan tetap setia pada Liu Bei, yang merupakan musuh Cao.

programme.title: Fight Back To School 3
programme.desc: Petugas polisi Chow Sing Sing ditugaskan untuk bekerja secara menyamar menyelidiki pembunuhan jutawan Million Wong, yang memiliki kemiripan luar biasa dengan Chow, dengan berpura-pura menjadi Wong yang menderita amnesia.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Long Wei mengalami gangguan pascatrauma usai kematian istrinya. Suatu hari, ia bertemu Amy yang bekerja di perusahaan teknologi VR dan diundang untuk menguji produk baru. Ia pun menjadi petarung VR perusahaan itu.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Sahabat baik Bodil dan Isabel, yang tampaknya telah menikah dengan bahagia, menyelinap pergi untuk melakukan perselingkuhan rahasia dengan menggunakan satu sama lain sebagai alibi. Namun, ketika Isabel terbunuh saat mereka seharusnya bersama. Bodil terjebak dalam jaringan kebohongannya sendiri.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Seorang aktor berusaha meyakinkan sesosok wanita untuk berperan sebagai Samantha dalam film Bewitched yang dibuat ulang. Namun, ia tidak menyadari bila wanita itu ternyata benar-benar seorang penyihir!

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Seorang detektif Hong Kong mengalami kecelakaan fatal yang melibatkan sebuah medali misterius dan berubah menjadi seorang prajurit abadi dengan kekuatan luar biasa.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire 2
programme.desc: Perampok kuburan menemukan vampir yang diawetkan. Saat mengangkut vampir anak, mantra yang mengikatnya hilang, dan ia berteman dengan penduduk setempat. Vampir orang tua terbangun dan melarikan diri. Tabib herbal mengejar untuk menghancurkan mereka.

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Kung Fu Jungle mengisahkan seorang instruktur bela diri yang dipenjara setelah sebuah insiden fatal. Ketika seorang pembunuh berantai mulai menargetkan para ahli kung fu, ia bekerja sama dengan polisi dengan imbalan kebebasan. Pertarungan hidup dan mati pun terjadi dalam menghadapi sang pembunuh.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: Seorang agen kekaisaran diejek karena berbagai penemuannya, hingga istrinya yang suportif mendorongnya untuk menghadiri sebuah konferensi, yang sebenarnya adalah jebakan untuk membunuh semua dokter yang melayani kaisar, di mana penemuan-penemuan gilanya menjadi berguna.

programme.title: Coba-Coba Cintanya Bikin Terjaga-Jaga
programme.desc: Ryan adalah seorang duda beranak satu yang berjualan mainan keliling untuk memenuhi kebutuhan hidupnya sehari-hari. Pada suatu hari, tanpa sengaja ia bertemu dengan Rosa seorang gadis yang merupakan seorang selebgram terkenal (Valerie Ivanka). Suatu saat ketika anak Ryan yang akan menyebrang jalan dihampiri selebgram tersebut karena si gadis khawatir melihat anak kecil itu. Tanpa diduga, Ryan malam memvideokan aksi selebgram tersebut. Ryan menuduh si perempuan itu akan menculik anaknya. Rosa berusaha untuk melakukan pembelaan, tapi Ryan tidak mau mendengarkannya ia bersikukuh kalau Rosa akan menculik anaknya. Video yang dibuat oleh Ryan tersebut menjadi sangat viral di media sosial dan membuat citra sang selebgram menjadi turun. Oleh karena itulah, manager Rosa meminta Rosa untuk melakukan pendekatan kepada Ryan agar Ryan mau memberikan klarifikasi.

programme.title: LITTLE ANGEL SEASON 2
programme.desc: Bernyanyilah bersama Bayi John dan keluarganya dengan lagu anak-anak klasik dan lagu-lagu baru yang menarik yang membantu anak-anak prasekolah mempelajari semua tentang dunia

programme.title: Tayo In Real Life
programme.desc: Apa yang akan terjadi hari ini? Mari kita lihat keseharian bus kecil Tayo dan teman-temannya.

programme.title: Pororo's Daily Diary
programme.desc: Apa kau bosan? Apa yang harus kita lakukan hari ini? Ayo bermain bersama Pororo dan teman-temannya!

programme.title: Tayo's Quiz & Show
programme.desc: Belajar bahasa Inggris dengan Tayo menggunakan berbagai suara di sekitar kita!

programme.title: TAYO
programme.desc: Di kota besar di mana berbagai kendaraan hidup bahagia bersama, bus kecil Tayo baru saja mulai mempelajari rutenya di kota. Ada banyak lagi yang harus dipelajari untuk Tayo. Tayo dan teman-temannya yang ramah, Rogi, Lani, dan Gani saling membantu untuk menjadi bus dewasa yang hebat.

programme.title: Pororo's Thematic Show
programme.desc: Tema cerita Pororo dan kawan-kawan. Anda akan diajak ke desa Porong Porong, sebuah tempat yang penuh dengan petualangan.

programme.title: Pororo Season 7
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang petualangan Pororo dan teman-temannya yang tinggal di desa bersalju Porong Porong Forest, yang sering menghadapi tantangan serta mempelajari pelajaran praktis dan moral dalam setiap episode.

programme.title: Pororo's Healthy Habits
programme.desc: Halo teman-teman? Saya Pororo! Bisakah kita belajar bersama tentang bagaimana tumbuh sebagai anak yang sehat?

programme.title: Harry's Character Battle
programme.desc: Pororo dan Tayo adalah teman yang sangat berbeda, tapi terkadang mereka sangat mirip karena mereka tidak pernah diam! Ada banyak kesamaan lainnya, jadi Harry melakukan analisis perbandingan lengkap tentang kedua sahabatnya ini! Mari kita mulai sekarang!

programme.title: Hazardous History S1, Ep 6
programme.desc: Perjalanan nostalgia dari masa lalu Amerika, mengungkap aktivitas dan produk sehari-hari yang mengejutkan, mulai dari mainan berbahaya hingga barang-barang rumah tangga yang membahayakan, dulu yang dianggap normal kini tak terbayangkan dalam masyarakat modern.

programme.title: The Pickers S26, Ep 388
programme.desc: Mike dan Frank adalah pengumpul barang antik yang berkeliling negara dan rela pergi ke mana saja demi peluang menemukan emas antik. Dengan bantuan Danielle, mereka sering kali terjebak dalam situasi lucu yang rumit.

programme.title: Bewitched S7, Ep 11
programme.desc: Di Season 7, Samantha berusaha menyeimbangkan kehidupan sihir dan keluarganya saat masalah baru muncul. Darrin menghadapi kesulitan kerja, Endora terus ikut campur, dan kekuatan Tabitha berkembang, membuat hidup mereka makin kacau dan lucu.

programme.title: Gambler Returns: Draw, Ep 1
programme.desc: Brady Hawkes kembali untuk petualangan judi lainnya dengan bantuan seorang nyonya rumah bernama Burgundy Jones dan beberapa karakter koboi TV terkenal.

programme.title: Knight Rider S1, Ep 13
programme.desc: Knight Rider Season 1 mengikuti Michael Knight, mantan polisi yang mendapat identitas baru setelah mengalami luka parah. Bekerja untuk Knight Foundation, Michael menangani berbagai kasus berbahaya bersama K.I.T.T., mobil canggih yang dilengkapi kecerdasan buatan dan hampir tidak dapat dihancurkan. Dengan teknologi, keberanian, dan kemampuan investigasi, mereka melawan kejahatan serta membantu orang yang membutuhkan.

programme.title: ALF S1, Ep 1
programme.desc: Ketika sesosok makhluk buruk rupa, yang suka memakan kucing, mendarat darurat di garasi keluarga Terran, mereka memperlakukannya sebagai tamu dan mengizinkannya tinggal bersama mereka saat ia mengomentari kebodohan umat manusia.

programme.title: Frasier S7, Ep 3
programme.desc: Frasier Season 7 mengikuti kehidupan Dr. Frasier Crane, seorang psikiater yang bekerja sebagai penyiar radio, saat menghadapi berbagai masalah dalam pekerjaan, keluarga, persahabatan, dan hubungan asmara. Bersama saudaranya Niles, ayahnya Martin, Daphne, dan Roz, Frasier menghadapi berbagai situasi kocak seputar cinta, pernikahan, pekerjaan, konflik keluarga, dan usahanya mengendalikan kehidupan yang semakin rumit.

programme.title: Mission Impossible S2, Ep 14
programme.desc: Mission: Impossible Season 2 mengikuti tim Impossible Missions Force (IMF) yang dipimpin Jim Phelps dalam menjalankan berbagai misi rahasia melawan penjahat, mata-mata, dan organisasi berbahaya. Dengan strategi cerdik, penyamaran, teknologi, dan kerja sama yang terkoordinasi, para agen harus menyelesaikan misi yang tampaknya mustahil tanpa diketahui lawan sekaligus menjaga identitas mereka.

programme.title: Rumahnya Anak : Kiko
programme.desc: Program animasi tentang Kiko, seekor anak ikan mas koki. Cerita bermula saat danau tempat tinggal Kiko tercemar limbah beracun akibat ulah sembrono manusia. Hal ini membuat Kiko dan kawan-kawannya berubah menjadi mutan. Mereka pun tumbuh menjadi makhluk air yang bisa bicara, layaknya manusia. Dan, petualangan pun dimulai.

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko, seekor anak ikan mas koki yang sangat mandiri, walaupun ia anak tunggal. Kiko selalu riang dan memiliki empat sahabat baik yaitu Lola si ikan diskus, Ting Ting si kepiting, Patino si ikan patin dan Poli si ikan cupang. Di sisi lain, sosok antagonis, Karkus si ikan lele dan Pupus si belut, selalu membuat ricuh kehidupan Kiko.

programme.title: The Revenant
programme.desc: Seorang penjelajah perbatasan dalam ekspedisi perdagangan bulu pada tahun 1820-an berjuang untuk bertahan hidup setelah diterkam beruang dan ditinggalkan dalam keadaan sekarat oleh anggota tim berburunya sendiri.

programme.title: The Librarian: Solomon's Mines (Rock Action)
programme.desc: Pustakawan yang berubah menjadi petualang, Flynn Carsen, berusaha menemukan tambang milik Raja Solomon.

programme.title: Assassin's Creed (Rock Action)
programme.desc: Seorang pria menjelajahi kenangan leluhurnya di Spanyol pada abad ke-15 dan memperoleh keterampilan dari perkumpulan rahasia misterius bernama Assassin untuk menghadapi organisasi Templar yang menindas di masa kini.

programme.title: Red Sun
programme.desc: Pada tahun 1870, sekelompok penjahat merampok kereta dan mencuri pedang seremonial Jepang yang akan diberikan sebagai hadiah kepada Presiden Amerika Serikat, sehingga memicu perburuan untuk merebutnya kembali.

programme.title: Back To The Future 3
programme.desc: Terdampar di tahun 1955, Marty McFly mengetahui kematian Doc Brown di tahun 1885 dan harus kembali ke masa lalu untuk menyelamatkannya. Tanpa bahan bakar yang tersedia untuk DeLorean, keduanya harus mencari cara untuk melarikan diri dari Old West sebelum Emmett dibunuh.

programme.title: The Legend (Rock Action)
programme.desc: Para ahli bela diri bergabung dengan Perkumpulan Bunga Teratai Merah untuk menggulingkan kaisar jahat. Gubernur memburu anggota perkumpulan tersebut. Seorang praktisi kung fu jatuh cinta pada putri seorang pedagang di tengah kontes kung fu untuk memperebutkan hatinya. Komedi pembalikan peran gender pun terjadi.

programme.title: Doomsday
programme.desc: Sebuah film thriller aksi futuristik di mana sebuah tim bekerja untuk mencegah bencana yang mengancam masa depan umat manusia.

programme.title: Curse Of King Tut's Tomb, Pt 1
programme.desc: Pencarian makam Raja Tut berubah jadi petualangan hidup-mati. Danny Freemont ingin melindungi kekuatannya, sementara Morgan Sinclair berniat memanfaatkannya untuk menguasai dunia.

programme.title: Curse Of King Tut's Tomb, Pt 2
programme.desc: Kesimpulan dari petualangan arkeolog pemberani Danny Freemont, yang bertekad untuk mengungkap rahasia tentang kehidupan dan kematian firaun Mesir legendaris Tutankhamun.

programme.title: Runaway Jury
programme.desc: Seorang juri, seorang pengacara, dan seorang wanita misterius menjadi penghalang bagi seorang pria yang berusaha memanipulasi sebuah sidang besar yang penuh ketegangan.

programme.title: The Big Boss
programme.desc: Ye Mu Xi adalah gadis cerdas dan energik yang akhirnya duduk di bangku kelas 1 SMA. Dia sangat bersemangat untuk tahun ajaran baru karena sekarang dia akhirnya akan berpisah dari teman masa kecilnya yang menyebalkan, Liao Dan Yi. Karena merasa hancur, dia menyusun rencana untuk merebut gelar ketua kelas dari teman masa kecilnya yang sempurna.

programme.desc: Seorang pilot kamikaze yang dihantui rasa bersalah karena selamat berusaha menebus dosanya ketika monster raksasa yang gagal dibunuhnya berubah bentuk akibat radiasi dari uji coba bom atom dan mengepung Jepang pascaperang.

programme.desc: Saat Orson, karyawan terbaru The Authority, mendapati dirinya terjebak dalam absurditas kehidupan korporat, keterasingannya semakin dalam ketika ia menemukan sebuah ruangan yang menurutnya tidak ada.

programme.title: A Culinary Journey
programme.desc: A Culinary Journey mengajak pemirsa menyusuri berbagai daerah untuk mengenal kekayaan kuliner lokal. Setiap episode menampilkan bahan-bahan khas, resep tradisional, serta kisah para koki, juru masak rumahan, dan pelaku kuliner yang menjaga warisan gastronomi daerahnya. Dipadukan dengan unsur perjalanan dan budaya, program ini memperlihatkan bagaimana makanan menjadi bagian penting dari identitas dan kehidupan masyarakat.

programme.title: Show Biz
programme.desc: Show Biz menghadirkan berbagai informasi terkini seputar industri hiburan, mulai dari kabar selebritas, film, serial televisi, musik, hingga gaya hidup. Program ini juga menyuguhkan liputan di balik layar, wawancara eksklusif dengan para artis, serta ulasan mengenai tren dan peristiwa terbaru di dunia entertainment. Dengan penyajian yang ringan dan informatif, Show Biz menjadi sumber informasi bagi penonton yang ingin mengikuti perkembangan industri hiburan.

programme.title: The Borderless World
programme.desc: The Borderless World menghadirkan laporan mendalam mengenai berbagai peristiwa internasional, mulai dari politik, ekonomi, teknologi, budaya, hingga isu sosial yang berkembang di berbagai belahan dunia. Melalui peliputan langsung, wawancara, dan analisis yang komprehensif, program ini memberikan perspektif yang lebih luas terhadap berbagai isu global sekaligus menyoroti dampaknya terhadap kehidupan masyarakat.

programme.title: Stylish Man: The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man: The Chef adalah salah satu program memasak paling populer di Taiwan yang telah menghibur pemirsa sejak 2006. Dipandu oleh Sam Tseng dan Genie Chuo bersama chef profesional James dan Wu Bing-Cheng, setiap episode menghadirkan demonstrasi memasak, kompetisi kuliner, tantangan bertema, serta kehadiran bintang tamu dari kalangan selebritas. programme.title: Battle Tour

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Diproduksi oleh Sanlih E-Television, Hot Door Night merupakan salah satu acara variety paling populer di Taiwan. Dengan perpaduan hiburan, kompetisi, dan interaksi spontan antar selebritas, acara ini telah menjadi favorit pemirsa serta meraih berbagai penghargaan bergengsi, termasuk Golden Bell Awards.

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness

programme.title: Gigantosaurus
programme.desc: Rocky, Bill, Tiny dan Mazu adalah empat dinosaurus muda yang tumbuh pada periode Cretaceous. Mereka sekawanan dinosaurus yang selalu mencari petualangan baru di setiap tempat yang mereka kunjungi. Gunung berapi baru bermunculan setiap saat, brachiosaurus berleher panjang dan triceratops raksasa berkeliaran bebas, hujan meteor menerangi langit malam dan Gigantosaurus yang ganas menguasai semuanya. Bisakah mereka berteman dengan Giganto, sang Raja Dinosaurus.

programme.title: The Spectral Lands
programme.desc: The Avengers prepare for a party with a surprise guest when Ultron crashes the preparations by using mind control on Iron Man. While trying to rescue their leader, the rest of the team discovers that Baron Stucker, HYDRA, and Yellowjacket are in on Ultron’s plans. While preparing for a party at Avengers’ Tower, THE AVENGERS (IRON MAN, CAPTAIN AMERICA, BLACK WIDOW, HAWKEYE, THOR, HULK and VISION) notice Iron Man acting strangely. When Iron Man volunteers to go out and get more ice, they find it odd: when has Tony every volunteered to get anything? Suddenly, ULTRON appears on a screen: he’s taken control of Iron Man! To make matters worse, Ultron takes over all the versions of Iron Man’s armor and they fly off! The Avengers must now fight one of their own, and they’re not sure what to do! Cap and Thor lead the charge, but can’t fend off Iron Man and Ultron’s Minions. Meanwhile, Black Widow, Hawkeye and Hulk track down a signal that seems to be controlling Iron Man from a castle in the “Little Sokovia” section of New York. There they fight HYDRA and BARON VON STRUCKER and learn that YELLOWJACKET is the “bug” that infected Iron Man’s suit for Ultron. To help break Iron Man free from Ultron’s control, the Avengers call in their own bug...ANT MAN! Finally, the Avengers confront Ultron and his Ultron Minions as they attack Avengers’ Tower. Ultron’s ultimate plan: use all the data/stuff they’ve stolen to free the newly rebuilt IRON LEGION, destroy the Avengers, and control the world. Tony dons the hastily repaired Hulk Buster Armor and it’s on! It’s a huge battle as the Avengers try to save their beloved HQ and defeat Ultron. Will they succeed? And, more importantly, can their party be saved after Ultron tries to take down their Tower?

While preparing for a party at Avengers’ Tower, THE AVENGERS (IRON MAN, CAPTAIN AMERICA, BLACK WIDOW, HAWKEYE, THOR, HULK and VISION) notice Iron Man acting strangely. When Iron Man volunteers to go out and get more ice, they find it odd: when has Tony every volunteered to get anything? Suddenly, ULTRON appears on a screen: he’s taken control of Iron Man! To make matters worse, Ultron takes over all the versions of Iron Man’s armor and they fly off! The Avengers must now fight one of their own, and they’re not sure what to do! Cap and Thor lead the charge, but can’t fend off Iron Man and Ultron’s Minions. Meanwhile, Black Widow, Hawkeye and Hulk track down a signal that seems to be controlling Iron Man from a castle in the “Little Sokovia” section of New York. There they fight HYDRA and BARON VON STRUCKER and learn that YELLOWJACKET is the “bug” that infected Iron Man’s suit for Ultron. To help break Iron Man free from Ultron’s control, the Avengers call in their own bug...ANT MAN! Finally, the Avengers confront Ultron and his Ultron Minions as they attack Avengers’ Tower. Ultron’s ultimate plan: use all the data/stuff they’ve stolen to free the newly rebuilt IRON LEGION, destroy the Avengers, and control the world. Tony dons the hastily repaired Hulk Buster Armor and it’s on! It’s a huge battle as the Avengers try to save their beloved HQ and defeat Ultron. Will they succeed? And, more importantly, can their party be saved after Ultron tries to take down their Tower?

While preparing for a party at Avengers’ Tower, THE AVENGERS (IRON MAN, CAPTAIN AMERICA, BLACK WIDOW, HAWKEYE, THOR, HULK and VISION) notice Iron Man acting strangely. When Iron Man volunteers to go out and get more ice, they find it odd: when has Tony every volunteered to get anything? Suddenly, ULTRON appears on a screen: he’s taken control of Iron Man! To make matters worse, Ultron takes over all the versions of Iron Man’s armor and they fly off! The Avengers must now fight one of their own, and they’re not sure what to do! Cap and Thor lead the charge, but can’t fend off Iron Man and Ultron’s Minions. Meanwhile, Black Widow, Hawkeye and Hulk track down a signal that seems to be controlling Iron Man from a castle in the “Little Sokovia” section of New York. There they fight HYDRA and BARON VON STRUCKER and learn that YELLOWJACKET is the “bug” that infected Iron Man’s suit for Ultron. To help break Iron Man free from Ultron’s control, the Avengers call in their own bug...ANT MAN! Finally, the Avengers confront Ultron and his Ultron Minions as they attack Avengers’ Tower. Ultron’s ultimate plan: use all the data/stuff they’ve stolen to free the newly rebuilt IRON LEGION, destroy the Avengers, and control the world. Tony dons the hastily repaired Hulk Buster Armor and it’s on! It’s a huge battle as the Avengers try to save their beloved HQ and defeat Ultron. Will they succeed? And, more importantly, can their party be saved after Ultron tries to take down their Tower?

Cap and Thor lead the charge, but can’t fend off Iron Man and Ultron’s Minions. Meanwhile, Black Widow, Hawkeye and Hulk track down a signal that seems to be controlling Iron Man from a castle in the “Little Sokovia” section of New York. There they fight HYDRA and BARON VON STRUCKER and learn that YELLOWJACKET is the “bug” that infected Iron Man’s suit for Ultron. To help break Iron Man free from Ultron’s control, the Avengers call in their own bug...ANT MAN! Finally, the Avengers confront Ultron and his Ultron Minions as they attack Avengers’ Tower. Ultron’s ultimate plan: use all the data/stuff they’ve stolen to free the newly rebuilt IRON LEGION, destroy the Avengers, and control the world. Tony dons the hastily repaired Hulk Buster Armor and it’s on! It’s a huge battle as the Avengers try to save their beloved HQ and defeat Ultron. Will they succeed? And, more importantly, can their party be saved after Ultron tries to take down their Tower?

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: The Heart Of Me [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Set in 1930s London with two sisters, Madeleine married to Rickie, and Dinah, who falls in love with him.

programme.title: The Heart Of Me [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Set in 1930s London with two sisters, Madeleine married to Rickie, and Dinah, who falls in love with him.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: All I See Is You [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Gina is a beautiful young woman who's still haunted by the accident that took her sight years earlier. Living in Bangkok with her husband, James, she undergoes a cutting-edge operation that restores the vision to her right eye. Now that Gina can see again, she slowly starts to realize that her newfound independence makes James feel jealous, threatened and insecure.

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: Gerry [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Friends Gerry (Casey Affleck) and Gerry (Matt Damon) hike into Death Valley, but they stray so far from the trail that they have no idea how to get back. Initially, they maintain morale by rehashing old stories and reciting inside jokes, but the gravity of their situation sinks in as a return to civilization becomes more unlikely. As the sheer scope, hypnotic pull and spirit-crushing mirages of the desert affect the men, their will to live and sense of identity is challenged and transformed.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Homeboy [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Though only in his 20s, professional boxer Johnny Walker is on the downswing of his career and suffering from a mild form of brain damage. Resettling in the beachfront resort of Asbury Park, N.J., he falls in with shady promoter Wesley Pendergass and meets kindhearted boardwalk operator Ruby. When Wesley proposes cutting Johnny in on a criminal undertaking, Johnny must choose between a life of crime and a settled future with Ruby.

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: An ex-con and his devoted wife must flee from danger when a heist doesn't go as planned.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Married to the Mob
programme.desc: Angela de Marco (Michelle Pfeiffer) is fed up with her gangster husband's (Alec Baldwin) line of work and wants no part of the crime world. When her husband is killed for having an affair with the mistress of mob boss Tony "The Tiger" Russo (Dean Stockwell), Angela and her son depart for New York City to make a fresh start. Unfortunately, Tony has set his sights upon Angela -- and so has an undercover FBI agent (Matthew Modine) looking to use her to bust Tony.

programme.title: Burnt
programme.desc: Adam Jones, former chef at one of Paris' premier restaurants, wants to turn his life around. After destroying his career with drug use and a manic drive for perfection, he is given another chance to fulfil his dreams of gaining three Michelin Stars. Returning to London, he assembles a crew to create one of the finest restaurants ever and gain the recognition he has always wanted in the culinary world, but the journey is certainly not an easy one.

programme.title: Make It Happen
programme.desc: Embarking on a journey to fulfil her dreams as a dancer, a young girl discovers a new style of dance that proves to be the source of both conflict and self-discovery.

programme.title: My Week With Marilyn
programme.desc: In 1956 England, Colin Clark (Eddie Redmayne) lands a job as a production assistant on the set of "The Prince and the Showgirl," starring Marilyn Monroe (Michelle Williams). Marilyn is also honeymooning with her new husband, playwright Arthur Miller, but the combined pressure of work and the demands of the Hollywood hangers-on is driving her to exhaustion. When Miller departs for Paris, Colin seizes the opportunity, to give Marilyn respite during a week in the idyllic British countryside.

programme.title: 3 Generations
programme.desc: Three of the most acclaimed actors of their generations in a human comedy for today. In this family, change is relative.

programme.title: Generation Um...
programme.desc: In New York, an escort-service driver (Keanu Reeves) and his two pretty friends (Bojana Novakovic, Adelaide Clemens) document their escapades with a stolen camera.

programme.title: Unlikely Angel
programme.desc: A dead country singer (Dolly Parton) seeks to get into heaven by uniting a troubled family during the holidays.

programme.title: Mannequin Two: On the Move
programme.desc: Although Jason (William Ragsdale) works as a department store clerk, he is also a reincarnated prince. Long ago, his beloved Jessie (Kristy Swanson) was snatched away from him by an evil wizard (Terry Kiser) who used his powers to transform her into wooden statue. Now Jessie is in Jason's department store as a mannequin. When he encounters her, she awakens from her thousand-year sleep. They quickly revive their romance, but the evil wizard has been reincarnated as well, and he's up to no good.

programme.title: Madhouse
programme.desc: Mark (John Larroquette) and Jessie (Kirstie Alley) get blindsided by an unexpected visit from Mark's cousin, Fred (John Diehl), and his pregnant wife, Bernice (Jessica Lundy). The family reunion is suddenly extended from five days to six months after an accident renders Bernice bedridden, and Mark and Jessie's life is slowly turned upside down by a seemingly never-ending stream of house guests, including Jessie's neurotic sister (Alison La Placa) and her obnoxious son (Bradley Gregg).

programme.title: Fatal Instinct
programme.desc: Ned Ravine (Armand Assante) is a police officer and lawyer who occasionally defends the delinquents he arrests. He crosses paths with a seductive femme fatale, Lola Cain (Sean Young), during an assignment and promptly begins an affair with her. Meanwhile, Ned's wife, Lana (Kate Nelligan), is deep in an affair of her own. Lana and her lover, Frank (Christopher McDonald), are planning to murder Ned in an elaborate fashion so they can collect on his triple indemnity life insurance policy.

programme.title: Married to the Mob
programme.desc: Angela de Marco (Michelle Pfeiffer) is fed up with her gangster husband's (Alec Baldwin) line of work and wants no part of the crime world. When her husband is killed for having an affair with the mistress of mob boss Tony "The Tiger" Russo (Dean Stockwell), Angela and her son depart for New York City to make a fresh start. Unfortunately, Tony has set his sights upon Angela -- and so has an undercover FBI agent (Matthew Modine) looking to use her to bust Tony.

programme.title: 10 Items or Less
programme.desc: An actor (Morgan Freeman) who is considering the role of a supermarket manager arrives at a grocery store on the outskirts of Los Angeles to do some field research. He subsequently becomes stranded, without a car or cell phone, and accepts a ride home with Scarlet (Paz Vega), a cashier who is about to interview for a new job. The actor rediscovers the essence of his craft while helping Scarlet gain the confidence she needs to change her life.

programme.title: Cadillac Man
programme.desc: Car dealer Joey O'Brien (Robin Williams) is spread as thin financially as he is in his love life. He's dating more women than he can remember, and the local toughs he's borrowed money from want it back. In a last-ditch effort to get out of debt, Joey struggles to sell a dozen cars in two days -- a task that becomes difficult when the husband (Tim Robbins) of Joey's secretary (Annabella Sciorra) barges into the dealership with a semi-automatic weapon and takes everyone hostage.

programme.title: Clerks II
programme.desc: Now in their 30s, slackers Dante and Randal find that they must change their lives and expand their horizons beyond pop culture and sex. After a disaster at their convenience store ends their employment there, they find new jobs at Mooby's, a fast-food empire.

programme.title: Date and Switch
programme.desc: Two high-school seniors make a pact to help each other lose their virginity before their prom, but their mission takes an unexpected turn when one announces that he's gay.

programme.title: Dirty Girl
programme.desc: Accompanied by her closeted gay buddy (Jeremy Dozier), a promiscuous teenager (Juno Temple) sets out to find her long-absent father.

programme.title: BloodRayne
programme.desc: In 18th-century Romania, after spending much of her life in a traveling circus, human-vampire hybrid Rayne (Kristanna Loken) escapes and plots to take down her evil vampire father, Kagan (Ben Kingsley). When she's discovered by three vampire hunters, Vladimir (Michael Madsen), Katarin (Michelle Rodriguez) and Sebastian (Matt Davis), she manages to convince them to spare her life and join her cause. But slaying a vampire as powerful as Kagan will be no easy task.

programme.desc: Beautiful Rayne (Natassia Malthe) teams with demon hunters to save a Western town from a gang of vampiric cowboys led by Billy the Kid (Zack Ward).

programme.title: Upstairs Inferno
programme.desc: For over 40 years, the 1973 New Orleans gay bar arson was considered the "Largest Gay Mass Murder in US History." Featuring heart-wrenching interviews with survivors, friends of victims, and witnesses, the film vividly examines the forgotten tragedy.

programme.title: Love You Right: An R&B Musical
programme.desc: When a series of events causes Will Clay's career as a successful R&B artist to hit rock bottom, he is forced to heal and come to grips with lessons on loyalty and love.

programme.title: Love Simple
programme.desc: Adam and Seta fall in love in a Brooklyn laundromat, but they've each got a secret and it's a full-time job to keep they're lies straight.

programme.title: Edie
programme.desc: A spirited 83-year-old widow travels to the Scottish Highlands to fulfill her dream of scaling the daunting Mt. Suilven and befriends a young climber.

programme.title: Caroline and Jackie
programme.desc: A birthday celebration exposes the fragile bond between two sisters. Dark secrets surface, unraveling the intricacies of their relationship and the profound impact of hidden truths on their lives.

programme.title: Fakin' Da Funk
programme.desc: A Chinese baby boy is adopted by a black couple in ATL. Seventeen years later he moves with his mom and brother to a black LA hood. A Chinese girl ends up in the same hood for the summer with a black family. Will they fit in?

programme.title: Hedgehog
programme.desc: The daughter of a late comic confronts her fears of performing.

programme.title: Meteor
programme.desc: In this disaster movie, Americans and Soviets must put aside their differences to save civilization from a huge meteor bearing down on the planet. Paul Bradley (Sean Connery) enlists the expertise of fellow scientist Alexei Dubov (Brian Keith), who is joined by his beautiful assistant, Tatiana Donskaya (Natalie Wood). Although Paul and Tatiana are attracted to each other, they wisely focus on taking out the meteor, which may still cause massive destruction even if it is partially damaged.

programme.title: Warlord
programme.desc: Warlord follows a peaceful Wood Elf Warlord, who despises violence, but is forced to take up arms when a cruel Sheriff uses brutal tactics against oppressed citizens. A rebellion grows, and all must choose between death and taxes.

programme.title: Upstairs Inferno
programme.desc: For over 40 years, the 1973 New Orleans gay bar arson was considered the "Largest Gay Mass Murder in US History." Featuring heart-wrenching interviews with survivors, friends of victims, and witnesses, the film vividly examines the forgotten tragedy.

programme.title: An Honest Liar
programme.desc: The incredible true story of the renowned magician turned skeptic and exposer of frauds and hoaxes, James "The Amazing" Randi.

programme.title: Confessions of an Action Star
programme.desc: A 'mockumentary' on the rise and fall of Chip and Dales dancer turned martial arts action star, Francis Allen Sledgewick, AKA Frank Sledge. When fame and fortune caused Frank to lose his sense of what's truly important.

programme.title: White Wall
programme.desc: Set in a wasteland ravaged by a virus called the VXII, enclosed by a large white wall, the last survivor from a brutal child internment camp reluctantly joins a bounty hunter to protect the idyllic life he has rebuilt.

programme.title: You Never Know
programme.desc: Immersed in a world filled with crime, drugs and betrayal, a group of friends have a tough time dealing with the daily pressures of life. With the support of one another, they come up with a plan to overcome their reality.

programme.title: Amber Road
programme.desc: The Amber Road is a place in the digital universe where anything can be bought, sold, and traded: a place where a person can fulfill their darkest desire or unleash their deepest depravity.

programme.title: The Immortalists
programme.desc: Two eccentric scientists struggle to create eternal youth in a world they call "blind to the tragedy of old age." Their scientific journeys ultimately become personal as they battle their own aging and suffer the losses of loved ones.

programme.title: Fade to Black
programme.desc: Peter Short, the charismatic CEO of a major Australian company, learns that he has only months to live after he is diagnosed with terminal oesophageal cancer. Not wanting to face a painful death, Peter sets out to have voluntary euthanasia legalised.

programme.title: Love You Right: An R&B Musical
programme.desc: When a series of events causes Will Clay's career as a successful R&B artist to hit rock bottom, he is forced to heal and come to grips with lessons on loyalty and love.

programme.title: The Compleat Al
programme.desc: A colorful reality marries an equally vivid imagination in a hilarious portrait of musician-satirist Alfred Matthew "Weird Al" Yankovic's personal life and career.

programme.title: Prison on Fire
programme.desc: Yiu (Tony Leung Ka Fai) is a young advertising executive in Hong Kong. One night, defending his father from attack, he accidentally shoves a street thug in front of a bus. Sentenced to three years in prison, Yiu is "fresh meat" for the hardened criminals and triad stooges that run things, and is preyed upon by sadistic guard Scarface (Roy Cheung). The virtuous Ching (Chow Yun-Fat) intervenes, teaching him the ropes of prison life, and a tender friendship develops between the two.

programme.title: Police Story
programme.desc: A kung-fu policeman must protect a female witness from a Hong Kong drug lord for whom she used to work.

programme.title: The Dark Crystal
programme.desc: Jen, raised by the noble race called the Mystics, has been told that he is the last survivor of his own race, the Gelflings. He sets out to try to find a shard of the dark crystal, a powerful gem that once provided balance to the universe. After the crystal was broken, the evil Skeksis used sinister means to gain control. Jen believes that he can repair the dark crystal and bring peace back to the world, if he can only find the remaining shard.

programme.title: The Air I Breathe
programme.desc: Four stories are linked by a Chinese proverb and overlapping characters. A usually unadventurous man (Forest Whitaker) loses big on a horse race and robs a bank to pay off a gangster (Andy Garcia). The gangster's nephew goes on the town with a hit man (Brendan Fraser) who can see into the future. The hit man falls for a pop star (Sarah Michelle Gellar) whose contract is owned by the gangster. The pop star has a rare blood type sought by a doctor (Kevin Bacon) trying to save the love of his life.

programme.title: Silent House
programme.desc: Sarah (Elizabeth Olsen) is working with her father (Adam Trese) and uncle (Eric Sheffer Stevens) to renovate an old family home to prepare it for sale. Long vacant, the house has no utilities, forcing the trio to rely on battery-operated lanterns to light their way. Sarah becomes separated from her relatives and soon finds she is trapped inside the cabin, with no contact with the outside world. Panic turns to real terror as the young woman experiences events that become increasingly ominous.

programme.title: Valentine: The Dark Avenger
programme.desc: A chance meeting with a film director leads to a waitress turned actress's transformation into a consummate superhero.

programme.title: Some Girl
programme.desc: Inexperienced in love and living in Los Angeles, aspiring actress Claire (Marissa Ribisi) longs to find that special someone. Unfortunately, she couldn't pick a more undeserving guy when she starts a relationship with womanizer Chad (Jeremy Sisto). Although her friend April (Juliette Lewis) warns her about him, it's not as if April doesn't have problems of her own -- namely a chronic inability to stay faithful to her longtime boyfriend, Neal (Michael Rapaport).

programme.title: Her Smell
programme.desc: Becky Something is a talented but self-destructive musician who seems determined to alienate everyone around her -- even at the cost of her own band's success.

programme.title: Prison on Fire 2
programme.desc: Ching escapes from prison to see his young son who has been put in an orphanage.

programme.title: The Company of Wolves
programme.desc: Wolves and werewolves lurk throughout the dreams of young Rosaleen (Sarah Patterson), who imagines that she must journey through a dark forest to live with her grandmother (Angela Lansbury). When Rosaleen meets a rugged hunter in the woods, she discovers that she has an animal-like attraction to him, leading to a macabre turn of events. The lupine-centric film also features stories within the main tale, told by both Rosaleen and her grandma, all of which have a supernatural bent.

programme.title: Paris Is Burning
programme.desc: This documentary focuses on drag queens living in New York City and their "house" culture, which provides a sense of community and support for the flamboyant and often socially shunned performers. Groups from each house compete in elaborate balls that take cues from the world of fashion. Also touching on issues of racism and poverty, the film features interviews with a number of renowned drag queens, including Willi Ninja, Pepper LaBeija and Dorian Corey.

programme.title: Agent Red
programme.desc: A Marine commander (Dolph Lundgren) accompanies a submarine carrying a chemical virus to a secure storage facility.

programme.title: Candy
programme.desc: A fatherly chemistry professor (Geoffrey Rush) indulges two young lovers (Heath Ledger, Abbie Cornish) in their ever-increasing heroin habits. Eventually the pair, an artist named Candy and an aspiring poet named Dan, become caught in a harrowing downward spiral of drug dependency and failed efforts to get clean.

programme.title: The Exorcist III
programme.desc: Police Lt. Kinderman (George C. Scott) notices similarities between his current murder investigation and the methods used by the Gemini killer (Brad Dourif) who was executed 15 years before. He soon discovers a hospitalized mental patient (Jason Miller) claiming to be the dead serial killer, but who looks uncannily like a priest Kinderman knew who died during an exorcism. As more bodies are found, Kinderman looks for connections between the two supposedly dead men.

programme.title: Jiminy Glick in Lalawood
programme.desc: A celebrity interviewer (Martin Short) and his wife (Jan Hooks) become tangled in a murder mystery involving a boozy actress, her family and her publicist.

programme.title: Dawg
programme.desc: After a lifetime of wooing, bedding and then leaving women without giving them a second thought, the self-centered Douglas Munford (Denis Leary) finds himself having to reflect on the hurt he has caused -- that is, if he wants a big inheritance from his late grandmother. According to Anna (Elizabeth Hurley), the estate's executor, Douglas must find 12 of the women he mistreated and get their forgiveness. Thus, the man who earned the nickname "Dawg" begins his journey of redemption.

programme.title: Sisters
programme.desc: Inquisitive journalist Grace Collier (Jennifer Salt) is horrified when she witnesses her neighbor, fashion model Danielle Breton (Margot Kidder), violently murder a man. Panicking, she calls the police. But when the detective arrives at the scene and finds nothing amiss, Grace is forced to take matters into her own hands. Her first move is to recruit private investigator Joseph Larch (Charles Durning), who helps her to uncover a secret about Danielle's past that has them both seeing double.

programme.title: Q: The Winged Serpent
programme.desc: A fleeing gangland flunky (Michael Moriarty) finds the New York nest of Aztec deity Quetzalcoatl, the man-eating flying serpent.

programme.title: Dead Ringers
programme.desc: Elliot (Jeremy Irons), a successful gynecologist, works at the same practice as his identical twin, Beverly (also Irons). Elliot is attracted to many of his patients and has affairs with them. When he inevitably loses interest, he will give the woman over to Beverly, the meeker of the two, without the woman knowing the difference. Beverly falls hard for one of the patients, Claire (Geneviève Bujold), but when she inadvertently deceives him, he slips into a state of madness.

programme.title: Bodyguards and Assassins
programme.desc: In 1906 Hong Kong, a newspaper editor and a tycoon learn of an assassination plot against Sun Yat-sen, and recruit a small band of ordinary men and women to protect him.

programme.title: My Best Fiend
programme.desc: Filmmaker Werner Herzog narrates an exploration of his love-hate relationship with actor Klaus Kinski.

programme.title: Sea Fever
programme.desc: Solitary marine-biology student Siobhán endures a week on a ragged fishing trawler, miserably at odds with the close-knit crew. But out in the deep Atlantic, an unfathomable life-form soon ensnares the boat. As members of the crew now succumb to a strange infection, Siobhán must overcome her alienation and win their trust -- before everyone is lost.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A killer called the Bat has claimed many lives in the small town inhabited by novelist Cornelia van Gorder (Agnes Moorehead) and her maid, Lizzie (Lenita Lane). As Cornelia implores Dr. Malcolm Wells (Vincent Price) to help her ailing maid, $1 million in the town's bank goes missing. With greed and fear reaching new heights, police Lt. Andy Anderson (Gavin Gordon) goes to Cornelia's house to investigate additional murders committed by the Bat.

programme.title: Clockwatchers
programme.desc: While she tries to determine her career goals, Iris (Toni Collette) becomes a temporary worker for Global Credit. There, all the regular employees ignore her, so she becomes friendly with three other temps: socializing actress Paula (Lisa Kudrow), conceited Jane (Alanna Ubach) and rebellious Margaret (Parker Posey). Though Margaret pines for a permanent job with the company, a rash of office thefts makes people suspicious of her, and Iris wonders whether to stand behind her new friend.

programme.title: The Five-Year Engagement
programme.desc: On their one-year anniversary, sous chef Tom Solomon (Jason Segel) plans to surprise his girlfriend, Violet Barnes (Emily Blunt), with an engagement ring. The lovers do end up engaged, but the fact that the proposal does not go exactly as planned proves to be a harbinger of things to come. Each time they try to set a date, various obstacles stand in their way. As more and more time passes, Tom and Violet begin to wonder if perhaps their marriage is not meant to be.

programme.title: The Dilemma
programme.desc: Longtime friends Ronny (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Kevin James) are partners in an auto-design firm. They are hard at work on a presentation for a dream project that would really launch their company. Then Ronny spots Nick's wife out with another man, and in the process of investigating the possible affair, he learns that Nick has a few secrets of his own. As the presentation nears, Ronny agonizes over what might happen if the truth gets out.

programme.title: The Break-Up
programme.desc: When Brooke (Jennifer Aniston), an art dealer, and Gary (Vince Vaughn), a tour-bus driver, finally call it quits in their relationship, neither is willing to move out of their shared condo. With their friends suggesting a series of underhanded tactics that fail to get either Brooke or Gary to cave in, the only solution is to become hostile roommates.

programme.title: Forgetting Sarah Marshall
programme.desc: Struggling musician Peter Bretter is better-known as the boyfriend of TV star Sarah Marshall. After she unceremoniously dumps him, he feels lost and alone but makes a last-ditch bid to get over it by going to Hawaii. However, she and her new boyfriend are there in the same hotel.

programme.title: Weird Science
programme.desc: Teen misfits Gary and Wyatt design their ideal woman on a computer, and a freak electrical accident brings her to life in the form of the lovely, superhuman Lisa. She outfits Gary and Wyatt in cool clothes, surprises them with a Porsche and helps them stand up to jerks Ian and Max. But, all the while, the boys must hide Lisa's existence from Chet, Wyatt's nightmare of a big brother.

programme.title: Problem Child
programme.desc: Ben is a good-hearted guy who's always wanted a son of his own, but so far he and his wife have had no success. The couple adopt Junior, a redheaded hellion who quickly makes their lives miserable. Disaster follows Junior wherever he goes, from camping trips that require emergency-room visits to birthday parties that turn into Grand Guignol affairs. When Ben's incensed family tells him to get rid of the boy, he starts to wonder if they might be right.

programme.title: Problem Child 2
programme.desc: Ben Healy (John Ritter) and his adopted son, the mischievous and destructive Junior (Michael Oliver), move to a new town for a fresh start in what happens to be "the divorcée capital of the world." Now the two face a multitude of women throwing themselves at Ben, though a new mom isn't what Junior wants. But Junior has more to worry about than his father's dates -- the little troublemaker might have met his match in Trixie Young (Ivyann Schwan), a small girl with a big chip on her shoulder.

programme.title: K-9
programme.desc: Michael Dooley is a cop who likes to work alone. But while working a case to bust Lyman, a notorious international drug lord, his boss assigns him a partner to assist. That partner is Jerry Lee, a drug-sniffing dog. At first Dooley can't stand his furry sidekick, especially since the dog seems to take pleasure in destroying Dooley's possessions. But when Dooley discovers that Jerry Lee's drug-sniffing skills are no joke, he warms up to the pooch.

programme.title: K-9: P.I.
programme.desc: Finally ready to settle into a relaxing retirement, police Detective Mike Dooley and his trusty dog, Jerry Lee, inadvertently find themselves in the middle of a robbery investigation -- as suspects. With his pension now frozen until his name is cleared, Dooley is back on the case with Jerry to find the real criminals. However, since he's a suspect of an FBI investigation and therefore unable to access his old police resources, Dooley has to get creative.

programme.title: K-911
programme.desc: This sequel follows police Detective Michael Dooley and his faithful German shepherd partner, Jerry Lee, who have been working together for 10 years. For Jerry Lee, this means that the canine is quite old, and has a hard time keeping up with police duties. Joining the pair is fellow officer Wendy Welles and her tough Doberman pinscher. Together, Dooley, Welles and their respective dogs attempt to track down a gun-wielding psychopath.

programme.title: A Dog's Purpose
programme.desc: A devoted dog discovers the meaning of its own existence through the lives of the humans it teaches to laugh and love. Reincarnated as multiple canines over the course of five decades, the lovable pooch develops an unbreakable bond with a kindred spirit named Ethan. As the boy grows older and comes to a crossroad, the dog once again comes back into his life to remind him of his true self.

programme.title: A Dog's Journey
programme.desc: Bailey is living the good life on the Michigan farm of his boy, Ethan and Ethan's wife Hannah. He even has a new playmate: Ethan and Hannah's baby granddaughter, CJ. The problem is that CJ's mom, Gloria, decides to take CJ away. As Bailey's soul prepares to leave this life for a new one, he makes a promise to Ethan to find CJ and protect her at any cost. Thus begins Bailey's adventure through many lives filled with love, friendship, and devotion.

programme.title: The Lincoln Lawyer
programme.desc: Mick Haller (Matthew McConaughey) is a charismatic defense attorney who does business out of his Lincoln Continental sedan. Mick spends most of his time defending petty crooks and other bottom-feeders, so it comes as quite a surprise when he lands the case of a lifetime: defending a Beverly Hills playboy (Ryan Phillippe) who is accused of attempted murder. However, what Mick initially thinks is an open-and-shut case with a big monetary reward develops into something more sinister.

programme.title: Alex Cross
programme.desc: Alex Cross (Tyler Perry) works as a detective/psychologist for the Detroit Police Department along with his lifelong friend, Tommy Kane (Edward Burns), and detective Monica Ashe (Rachel Nichols). Cross' latest case puts him on a collision course with Picasso (Matthew Fox), a cunning serial killer whose ultimate target is multinational industrialist Giles Mercier (Jean Reno). Cross must find a way inside Picasso's head not only to catch the killer but also to stem the violent urges Cross feels.

programme.title: City of Lies
programme.desc: Los Angeles Police Department detective Russell Poole has spent years trying to solve his biggest case -- the murders of The Notorious B.I.G. and Tupac Shakur -- but after two decades, the investigation remains open. Jack Jackson, a reporter desperate to save his reputation and career, is determined to find out why. In search of the truth, the two team up and unravel a growing web of institutional corruption and lies.

programme.title: Knox Goes Away
programme.desc: Diagnosed with a rapidly evolving form of dementia, a contract killer gets the chance to redeem himself by saving the life of his estranged son.

programme.title: Killing Them Softly
programme.desc: When rival crook Johnny Amato (Vincent Curatola) hatches a plan to rob a card game run by mob lackey Markie (Ray Liotta), he picks a low-rent thug named Frankie (Scoot McNairy) to do the job. Frankie picks a less-than-ideal partner (Ben Mendelsohn) to help him, but despite their combined incompetence, they manage to make off with the mob's money. In retaliation, Markie's bosses hire Jackie Cogan (Brad Pitt), a mob enforcer, to eradicate those responsible.

programme.desc: A frustrated suburban housewife and her best friend hatch an illegal coupon-club scheme that scams millions from corporations and delivers deals to legions of fellow coupon clippers. Hot on their trail is an unlikely duo -- a hapless loss-prevention officer and a determined U.S. postal inspector -- both looking to end their criminal enterprise.

programme.title: Bad Moms
programme.desc: Amy (Mila Kunis) has a great husband, overachieving children, beautiful home and successful career. Unfortunately, she's also overworked, exhausted and ready to snap. Fed up, she joins forces with two other stressed-out mothers (Kristen Bell, Kathryn Hahn) to get away from daily life and conventional responsibilities. As the gals go wild with their newfound freedom, they set themselves up for the ultimate showdown with PTA queen bee Gwendolyn and her clique of seemingly perfect moms.

programme.title: A Bad Moms Christmas
programme.desc: Under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla rebel against the challenges and expectations of the Super Bowl for moms: Christmas. As if creating the perfect holiday for their families isn't hard enough, they'll have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers when they come to visit.

programme.title: Joy Ride
programme.desc: When Audrey's business trip to Asia goes sideways, she enlists the help of Lolo, her childhood best friend, Kat, a college friend, and Deadeye, Lolo's eccentric cousin. Their epic, no-holds-barred experience becomes a journey of bonding, friendship, belonging and wild debauchery that reveals the universal truth of what it means to know and love who you are.

programme.sub-title: Going into Action! The Implacable New Admiral of the Fleet - Sakazuki!

programme.title: One Piece

programme.sub-title: In the Dark Recesses of the Holyland! A Mysterious Giant Straw Hat!

programme.sub-title: Sabo Enraged! The Tragedy of the Revolutionary Army Officer Kuma!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and the others become excited as they see familiar faces in a newspaper article about the Reverie while they close in on the Land of Wano. But this dangerous and foreboding land is as inaccessible as it is mysterious! The sea itself is a barrier!
programme.sub-title: Climbing Up a Waterfall! A Great Journey Through the Land of Wano's Sea Zone!

programme.sub-title: He'll Come! The Legend of Ace in the Land of Wano!

programme.sub-title: Side Story! Clash! Luffy vs. the King of Carbonation!

Ultron's ultimate plan: use all the data/stuff they've stolen to free the newly rebuilt IRON LEGION, destroy the Avengers, and control the world. Tony dons the hastily repaired Hulk Buster Armor and it's on! It's a huge battle as the Avengers try to save their beloved HQ and defeat Ultron. Will they succeed? While trying to rescue their leader, the rest of the team discovers that Baron Stucker, HYDRA, and Yellowjacket are in on Ultron's plans. While preparing for a party at Avengers' Tower, THE AVENGERS (IRON MAN, CAPTAIN AMERICA, BLACK WIDOW, HAWKEYE, THOR, HULK and VISION) notice Iron Man acting strangely. When Iron Man volunteers to go out and get more ice, they find it odd: when has Tony every volunteered to get anything? Suddenly, ULTRON appears on a screen: he's taken control of Iron Man! To make matters worse, Ultron takes over all the versions of Iron Man's armor and they fly off! The Avengers must now fight one of their own, and they're not sure what to do! Cap and Thor lead the charge, but can't fend off Iron Man and Ultron's Minions. Meanwhile, Black Widow, Hawkeye and Hulk track down a signal that seems to be controlling Iron Man from a castle in the “Little Sokovia” section of New York. There they fight HYDRA and BARON VON STRUCKER and learn that YELLOWJACKET is the “bug” that infected Iron Man's suit for Ultron. To help break Iron Man free from Ultron's control, the Avengers call in their own bug...ANT MAN!

programme.desc: The Knights are tasked with protecting the King's valuable Ned Knights comic book during the Bookingheim Knight-a-Con. But with all the costumed kids there, will they recognize the real Jestro and Book of Monsters coming to get them? King Halbert instructs the Knights that they must take his valuable Ned Knights comic book to the “Knight-a-Kon” in Bookingham. It will be the first be first prize at the Knight-a-Kon. But the Book of Monsters wants the book, too. Having devoured Ned Knightly comic books in it's down time it has become fanatically obsessed with the storyline. General Magmar suggests they simply attack the place and take what they want, but Jestro tells them they can't: everyone will be in costume and they'll be thousands of comics there. This calls for a clever “infiltration” mission (which will also allow Jestro to see the Kon, which he's always wanted to do.) So Jestro goes into the Kon with the BOM and some monsters. And it's easy because everyone is in costume Jestro, the BOM and their monsters fit right in at the convention and Clay and crew have their work cut out for them trying to separate fiend from fan. Macy keeps going on-and-on about the story in the King's comic book as the Knights keep a watchful eye on it. Robin even shows up in the “Minitrex” – a small version of the Fortrex he built just for the Knight-a-Kon. He's convinced he can win the costume competition that is the big closing event for the Kon. At the end of the Kon there's a big awards ceremony for “Best Costume.” The prize: “Ned Knightly, Knight of Knighton, Issue #1.” The BOM must get it and scheme to get closer to it during the costume contest. He's just…about…to get the book when…the impatient Magmar attacks! Everyone thinks it's part of the big show! “Ned Knightly, Knight of Knighton, Issue #1” is tossed from person-to-person-to-person in the melee. The Knights must do something, but they're too far away from the Fortrex to download any NEXO-Power. Robin pulls up in his Minitrex they can use it to get NEXO-Power! Robin wins the best costume for his Minitrex and wins the Ned Knightly Comic which he then gives to Macy…she deserves to read it.
